description: Returns events of one kind between start and end (YYYY-MM-DD), clipped to as_of. kind='earnings' (company report dates, symbol and timing) or kind='macro' (economic releases such as CPI, payrolls, FOMC). Max 5000 rows per page.

all_releases.description: kind=macro only: true returns every data release (hundreds a week); default returns market-moving releases (CPI, payrolls, GDP, PCE, retail sales, claims, ISM ...).

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_events
title: Get events
